# One template per block: `=== <name> <bas|cls>`, then the module text. `{k}` is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== namedarg bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    x = o.f({k}:=1)
End Sub
=== namedargstmt bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    o.f {k}:=1
End Sub
=== gotolabel bas
Sub Probe()
    GoTo {k}
End Sub
=== gosublabel bas
Sub Probe()
    GoSub {k}
End Sub
=== resumelabel bas
Sub Probe()
    Resume {k}
End Sub
=== onerrorlabel bas
Sub Probe()
    On Error GoTo {k}
End Sub
=== exitword bas
Sub Probe()
    Exit {k}
End Sub
=== optionword bas
Option {k}
=== withmember bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    With o
        x = .{k}
    End With
End Sub
=== withtarget bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    With o
        .{k} = 1
    End With
End Sub
=== callword bas
Sub Probe()
    Call {k}
End Sub
=== labelcolon bas
Sub Probe()
{k}: x = 1
End Sub
=== labeldef bas
Sub Probe()
    GoTo L
{k}:
End Sub
=== withcall bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    With o
        .{k} 1
    End With
End Sub
